concept_gloss.applicability: Sözün zihinde bulunduğu ama henüz sesle açıklanmadığı bağlamlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İçte bulunma ve açıklanmama sınırını korur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin zihninde veya içinde tasarladığı, henüz sesle dışa vurmadığı söz veya anlamdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözün içte tasarlanmış fakat açığa vurulmamış olmasıdır.
Söz, kişinin içinde bulunur ve sesli ifadeye dönüşmeden önceki aşamadadır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin içinde tutup açıklamadığı söz bağlamında doğal aktarım sağlar.

error_profile.preserves: İçte tutulan ve açıklanmayan sözü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içte tasarlanan ve açığa vurulmamış sözdür; sesli ifade veya mezhep inancı değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dışa vurulmadan önce zihinde tasarlanan veya kişinin içinde tuttuğu sözü anlatır. Geçici çerçeve bu iç söz anlamını doğru verir ve sesli söyleme ile inanç anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım içte söz bulunduğunu belirten kalıpla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular iç düşünce, sır, zihinde söz, susma ve kök içi sesli söyleme açısından tarandı; aşama farkını gösterenler yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aşama farkı belirleyicidir: bu dal iç tasarımda kalır, komşu sesli ifadeye dönüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sözün içte kalmış ve açığa çıkmamış aşamasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sözün sesle dışa vurulmuş biçimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de söz veya anlam içeriğiyle ilgilidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düşünce çizgisine inanma veya bağlı olma anlamındaki kalıp için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Görüşe inanma ve benimseme çekirdeğini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir görüşe, mezhebe veya düşünce çizgisine inanıp onu benimsemek anlamındaki kalıp kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir görüş veya inancı benimsemektir.
Kullanım söz söylemeyi değil, kişinin bağlı olduğu düşünce veya mezhebi bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin belli bir düşünceye bağlılığı anlatıldığında doğal çeviridir.

error_profile.preserves: Benimseme ve bağlı görüş anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal görüş benimseme kalıbıdır; salt telaffuz veya iç düşünce değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme kalıbını bir görüşe veya mezhebe inanma ve onu benimseme anlamında açıklar. Bu, sadece sözlü ifade veya içte kalmış söz değil, bağlı olunan düşünce veya inanç yönelimidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım yalnız görüş veya mezhep benimseme kalıbına bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular görüş, mezhep, inanç, iç söz ve topluluk adı açısından tarandı; benimseme çekirdeğini ayıranlar yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu iç bağlılığın genel adıdır; bu dal söz kalıbının görüşe bağlılık anlamıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal söyleme kalıbıyla bir görüş veya mezhebi benimsemektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kalbin bir şeye bağlanması ve inanç veya görüşün sağlamlaşmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de zihinsel bağlılık ve inanç alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kişinin bağlılık eylemidir; komşu dal bağlı olunan sistem veya yolun adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişinin bir görüşü benimsediğini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal din, yol veya izlenen topluluk düzeni anlamındaki daha nesnel sistemi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de inanç ve izlenen yol alanına girebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda bağlı olunan görüş belirleyicidir; komşu dalda yalnız dışa vurulmamış söz veya anlam vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir görüşe inanma veya onu benimsemedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal söylenmemiş iç sözdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de iç zihinsel alanla ilişkilidir.

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, bir görüşe veya mezhebe inanma anlamındaki kalıp kullanımını verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözsüz bir nesne veya durumun anlam bildirdiği bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözsüz belirtme ve gösterme çekirdeğini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir durumun veya nesnenin söz söylemeden bir anlamı belli etmesi, sanki konuşuyormuş gibi işaret vermesi anlamındaki kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözsüz durumun bir şeyi belli etmesidir.
Bir kabın doluluğunun artık yeter anlamını belli etmesi bu tür kullanıma örnektir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözsüz durumun mecazi biçimde konuşur gibi anlatıldığı örnekte uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözsüz belirtmeyi konuşur gibi anlatma biçimini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sözsüz belirtmedir; insanın sesli konuşması veya içe doğan anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi cansız veya sözsüz bir durumun bir şeyi belli etmesini söyleme diye adlandırır. Çerçeve bunu konuşan insanın sözü değil, durumun gösterdiği anlam olarak doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım, durumun sözsüz belirtmesi örneğine bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular işaret, belirti, sözsüz gösterme, yalan söz ve kök içi sesli söyleme açısından tarandı; gösterme sınırları yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal verilen kalıpta durumun sözsüz anlam bildirmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: durumuyla belli etme / konuşur gibi gösterme
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kitap, delil veya işaretin anlamı konuşur gibi göstermesini daha geniş anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de sözsüz belirtmenin konuşmaya benzetilmesini paylaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel gösterge veya delildir; bu dal göstergeyi söz söylemeye benzeten özel kullanımdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir durumun konuşur gibi anlam bildirmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeye ulaştıran işaret, delil veya yol gösterme anlamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir anlamı gösterme alanındadır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye içten biçimde önem vermek, onunla gerçekten ilgilenmek anlamındaki kalıp kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir şeye samimi ilgi ve önem göstermektir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içten ilgi ve özen kalıbıdır; inanç benimseme dalına genellenmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme kalıbını bir şeye içten ve gerçek bir ilgi gösterme anlamında açıklar. Bu, inanç veya mezhep benimseme anlamına benzer görünse de asıl çekirdek değer verme ve özen göstermedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli söz kalıbıyla içten önemsemeyi anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Düşünce bilimi bağlamında bir şeyin ne olduğunu belirleyen tanım veya sınır bildirimi için söz kelimesinin kullanılmasıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Tanım bildirme işlevini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal teknik tanım kullanımıdır; sıradan sözlü ifade anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi düşünce bilimi bağlamında sözün bir şeyin tanımı veya sınır bildirimi için kullanıldığını açıklar. Bu, normal konuşma değil, teknik tanım işleviyle sınırlı bir kalıptır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım, teknik tanım bildiren özel kalıplara bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular sınır, tanım, çeşit, son nokta ve kök içi söz anlamları açısından tarandı; teknik tanım sınırını gösterenler yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal söz kelimesinin teknik tanım anlamında kullanılmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sınır, son nokta, ayırıcı çizgi ve kural sınırı alanını genişçe kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir şeyin belirleyici sınırını bildirme alanını paylaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda fiziksel veya mekansal sınır ağır basar; bu dal kavramsal tanım sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal teknik tanım bildiren söz kullanımıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesneler veya yerler arasındaki engel ve sınırdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal işitilen hitap olmaksızın içe doğan anlamdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda sesli hitap yoktur; komşuda ses çıkarma ve çağırma anlamın çekirdeğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çağırmak için çıkarılan sesli nida veya haykırıştır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de birine yönelen bildirim alanına bağlanabilir.

text.arabic_uthmani: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ

baseline.text: İnsanlar, "İnandık" demeleriyle sınanmadan bırakılacaklarını mı sandılar?

findings.text: Sınama, söylenen inancı oluşturmaktan çok onun içeriğini görünür ve sınanabilir hale getirir.
Bırakılmamak, inanç iddiasının yalnız söz halinde donup kalmayıp sonuç doğuran eyleme taşınmasıdır.
İbrahim'in daha sonra ateşe atılmak istenmesi, buradaki sınamaya dayanıklılığı ayıran bir ısı sınaması boyutu kazandırabilir.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain reckoning supplies the mistaken expectation that the proposed bargain will hold.
Release and non-interference supply the exemption the speakers expect.
Audible utterance is the claimed qualifying act in the bargain.
Heart-settling assent is the inward reality that the utterance claims.
Assay of a person or material is the inspection the expectation wrongly excludes.

changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects a causal bargain in which saying a belief claim purchases release from examination.
changed_reading.before: The ayah generally warns that believers will encounter hardship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction links reckoning, being left, saying, believing, and not being tested.

activation_trace.role: Inner security and trust provide the claimed stable state.
Leaving a thing on its present condition supplies the static state the question refuses.
Human and metallurgical assay supplies a process that tests the quality of the claimed state.

changed_reading.after: Testing is an assay that refuses to leave claimed inner security unverified and unchanged.
changed_reading.before: Testing is an external misfortune added after belief.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The asserted state of faith is placed directly against the negated passive of testing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Claimed heart-security is treated as material whose quality cannot simply be left in its announced state; assay distinguishes confidence from a merely named condition.

activation_trace.role: Visible human collectivity makes the claim a social category shared among people.
Speech circulating among people supplies the exploratory image of a public affiliation label.
Ordeal and pressure supply the load under which the public label is exposed.

changed_reading.after: A human collective voices a shared identity whose durability becomes publicly observable under pressure.
changed_reading.before: Each individual privately believes and then privately suffers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A human collective says a first-person-plural formula while remaining subject to a plural passive test.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance can function as a circulating affiliation label; ordeal then places a publicly shared identity, not only private conviction, under load.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies human assay as the initially open mechanism.
The repeated assay extends the mechanism historically and makes it an established process.
Uncovering something to a knower supplies the assay's manifest output.
Solidity and straightness turn truth from verbal accuracy into quality that withstands assay.
The contrary of truth supplies the contrasting output class.

changed_reading.after: The test is a disclosive assay whose output is the visible difference between speech-solid truth and a false claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate recurrence turns assay into a disclosure process: it yields an observable distinction between a claim with solidity and its contrary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, uncovering, solidity, and a truth/lie contrast; I supply the arrow that trial manifests the distinction. A live alternative is that the sequence announces judgment without making trial the means of disclosure.
structural_cues: 29:3 repeats the testing root and places two knowledge clauses around the truthful and the liars.
The prior peoples extend the process beyond the focus audience.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies a doubtful estimate of exemption.
The repeated estimate directly parallels and recalibrates the focus question.
Intentional action places deeds, not labels alone, inside the calculation.
Escaping a pursuer supplies the proposed outcome of getting beyond accountability.
Right judgment exposes the estimate as a bad assessment rather than a reliable forecast.

changed_reading.after: People miscalculate that a declared status can exempt them from the accountability their conduct cannot outrun.
changed_reading.before: People merely hope not to suffer after belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second matched reckoning question identifies the first as part of an escape calculus: actors estimate that either a claim or their maneuvering can put them beyond consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel questions, deliberate bad action, escape, and failed judgment; I infer that both questions expose one evasion logic. Alternatively, they may condemn two separate presumptions without equating their motives.
structural_cues: The paired openings use the same reckoning verb and parallel clauses introduced by 'that'.
Being left in 29:2 aligns with outstripping in 29:4 as two imagined exemptions.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the voiced profession whose adequacy is at issue.
Assent supplies the content claimed by the voice.
The repeated assent anchors the later sequence to the focus claim.
Purposive doing turns claimed assent into enacted conduct.
Soundness against corruption gives the enacted conduct its tested direction.
Fitness and suitability link sound deeds to entry among sound persons.

changed_reading.after: The claim seeks an enacted form: assay asks whether assent becomes purposive, sound conduct and a fit social identity.
changed_reading.before: The contrast is simply between spoken belief and later suffering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated conjunction of belief with intentional, repairing action gives the focus declaration an operational extension: the claim is carried into what one does and becomes fit for a community.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated belief-action pairings and social inclusion; I infer that action operationalizes what the focus utterance claims. A live alternative is that action accompanies belief without serving as its validating test.
structural_cues: 29:7 and 29:9 repeat the sequence 'believed and did sound deeds'.
29:9 moves from sound acts to inclusion among sound people.

activation_trace.role: The visible human collective supplies the focus population under test.
Voiced profession supplies the public allegiance claim.
Driving someone to the limit of hardship supplies coercive family pressure.
Divided divine allegiance supplies the demanded destination of that pressure.
Obedient yielding supplies the behavioral decision the pressure seeks.
The same human collective appears as both claimant class and source of trial, folding the focus subject back onto itself.
Repeated speech at pressure and support points exposes affiliation that can switch with circumstance.
The exact assent formula binds the opportunistic portrait to the focus declaration.
Harm that prevents settled ease gives social trial its felt pressure.
Making one thing into the status of another supplies the claimant's decisive misclassification.
Human ordeal names the pressure that the claimant mistakes for final punishment.
The inner source from which actions issue relocates evaluation beneath changing speech.

changed_reading.after: Testing is a contest of governing allegiances in which kinship, human harm, and expected support expose whether speech tracks conviction or opportunity.
changed_reading.before: Testing is an unspecified event that follows conversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing becomes competing social pressure. Kin press toward divided allegiance, the wider human collective inflicts harm, and an opportunistic claimant reclassifies that pressure and changes speech when support appears; the question is which demand governs action from within.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercion, refusal, social harm, equivalence-making, switched speech, and inner sources; I infer that trial reveals which allegiance controls conduct under rival pressures. Alternatively, 29:10 may portray a special opportunist rather than define every focus test.
structural_cues: 29:8 preserves goodness to parents while refusing obedience at the point of divided allegiance.
29:10 repeats the focus sequence of people, saying, belief, and testing, then adds harm, comparison, support, and changed speech.

activation_trace.role: Release supplies the untouched abandonment expected in the focus.
Leaving a trace behind supplies the productive remainder that reverses mere release.
A manifest sign identifies the remainder as evidence rather than debris.
Visibility and disclosure make the retained trace readable.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the later audience's use of the trace.

changed_reading.after: Non-exemption can produce what is left: a visible trace by which truth becomes available to later reasoners.
changed_reading.before: To be left means only to be abandoned or released from interference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later active use of the same leaving root reverses its valence: people expect release without process, but a judged place is left as a visible remainder through which later people can reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root recurrence, retained sign, visibility, and reasoning; I infer a reversal from exemption to evidentiary remainder. The live alternative is ordinary lexical recurrence without a designed answer to the opening question.
structural_cues: The exact leaving root recurs with an active first-person subject and an explicit sign as object.
The focus asks for persons to be left; 29:35 describes evidence left from a place after consequence.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the profession whose status is initially suspect.
Assent supplies the profession's claimed inward content.
A direct command to voice the profession rehabilitates saying as a legitimate act.
The exact assent formula binds the commanded speech to the focus wording.
Delivered revelation gives the confession explicit objects shared across interlocutors.
Divine unity fixes the confession's allegiance rather than leaving it objectless.
Yielding and handing oneself over give the voiced assent an embodied posture.

changed_reading.after: Profession is legitimate and even commanded when object-specified and yielded in posture; what fails is treating its utterance as immunity from assay.
changed_reading.before: Verbal profession is inherently suspect because it is verbal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same confession is later commanded, but it is supplied with objects, shared revelation, divine unity, and surrender. Speech itself is not disqualified; its treatment as a self-sufficient exemption is.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commanded matching formula plus specified objects and surrender; I infer that the focus criticizes exemption-by-formula rather than profession as such. Alternatively, the dialogical setting may license this speech without commenting on every profession.
structural_cues: 29:46 uses an imperative with the same 'say: we believe' formula as the focus.
The command expands the formula through two revelation objects, one deity, and a concluding first-person-plural submission.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the semantically open claim in the focus.
The same assent root takes an explicit false object, showing that assent alone does not guarantee truth.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the object in which trust can nevertheless settle.

changed_reading.after: Belief is object-directed trust; assay asks what the speakers actually trust when pressure makes competing objects operative.
changed_reading.before: Saying 'we believe' names a condition that validates itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later syntax attaches the belief root to falsehood. Therefore the bare claim in the focus is not self-authenticating: testing must disclose what actually receives the speaker's trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same assent root with a false object; I infer that trial indexes the bare claim to its operative object. A live alternative is that 29:52 concerns different speakers and sharpens vocabulary without defining the focus group.
structural_cues: 29:52 gives the belief verb an explicit object marked by the preposition.
The focus formula leaves its object unspoken inside a quoted first-person-plural claim.

activation_trace.role: Trial through hardship or ease supplies a two-condition testing frame.
Exclusive separation from partnership supplies the allegiance produced under danger.
Rescue by separation marks the transition from pressure to relief.
Restored divided allegiance supplies the failure revealed after rescue.
A protected spatial sanctuary supplies concrete physical exemption from surrounding danger.
The paired security and belief occurrences place physical safety beside the question of where trust settles.
Rapid snatching outside the sanctuary supplies the surrounding condition from which safety is exceptional.

changed_reading.after: Testing runs across changing conditions: danger may concentrate trust, while relief and protected safety reveal whether that trust endures.
changed_reading.before: Not being left means believers must undergo adverse events.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea-to-land reversal and the secure-sanctuary contrast make trial alternate between distress and relief. Danger can purify allegiance, while rescue and safety can expose its relapse; physical security is not proof of faithful trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies danger, purification, rescue, relapse, localized safety, and surrounding seizure; I infer that both pressure and relief test fidelity. Alternatively, only danger may be the test, with relapse treated as its aftermath.
structural_cues: 29:65 pivots temporally from danger, to exclusive devotion, to rescue, to renewed partnership.
29:67 places a secure sanctuary, surrounding seizure, and belief in falsehood in one contrastive question.

activation_trace.role: Assay supplies the opening model of evaluation.
Expending capacity under hardship supplies the tested person's active response.
Gentle direction toward way and truth supplies an outcome that develops the responder.
Traversable extended paths give guidance a processual rather than merely classificatory shape.
Doing what is good names the company in which the guided response settles.

changed_reading.after: Testing is also path-forming: exertion under load becomes the site where guidance opens and claimed faith acquires direction.
changed_reading.before: Testing only sorts fixed sincere and insincere identities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence adds a formative arrow to assay: effort under hardship is followed by guidance into paths and accompaniment with good-doers, so response within testing can open the route it evaluates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hardship-bearing effort followed by guidance, paths, and good-doing; I infer that testing can form the faith it discloses. A live alternative is that guidance is subsequent reward rather than a mechanism operating within trial.
structural_cues: The surah closes with those who strive followed by emphatic guidance into plural paths.
This response at 29:69 answers the opening passive testing question with active exertion.

remaining_uncertainties: The evidentiary-residue reading depends on treating the later leaving-root recurrence as an answer to the opening question rather than ordinary reuse.
The two-condition model may overextend the trial branch if relief is only aftermath rather than an active testing phase.
The commanded confession in 29:46 may be specialized to dialogue even though it corrects an anti-verbal reading of the focus.
The sufficiency and weak-shelter outliers are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified analogies.
strongest_changes: The immediate sequel makes testing a disclosive assay of solidity rather than undirected suffering.
The matched reckoning question exposes an exemption and escape calculus tied to conduct.
Later exact confessions rehabilitate speech while object-directed false belief shows why speech alone cannot authenticate itself.
Sea-to-land reversal and secure-sanctuary contrast show that both danger and relief can test where trust settles.
The closing striving-to-guidance sequence makes testing potentially formative as well as classificatory.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence repeatedly split terms that the focus initially compresses: speech from enactment, belief from its object, security from fidelity, release from evidentiary remainder, and assay from both disclosure and formation.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency and adequacy supply the exploratory possibility that the declaration is being treated as enough.
An explicit question whether something is sufficient activates the focus root's distant adequacy branch.
Sufficiency carried by divine witness relocates adequacy away from the claimant's self-account.

changed_reading.after: Secondarily, do they treat their declaration as a sufficient account, when the surah relocates sufficiency to delivered evidence and witness?
changed_reading.before: Do they merely reckon that they will be left?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus form most naturally activates reckoning, so the sufficiency branch is form-distant; it remains anchored in the focus reckoning root and is independently awakened by two later sufficiency questions. Render it only as a secondary lexical echo, not as the base translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reckoning root stands over the proposed adequacy of saying the belief formula.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust supply the protective state claimed by belief.
Being left in a condition supplies the wish that the claimed shelter remain undisturbed.
Assay supplies the load that reveals structural quality.
Protective alliance supplies the support on which a sheltering claim relies.
Dwelling and refuge give reliance a constructed shelter image.
Loss of strength supplies the structural failure exposed when the refuge is tested.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the declaration can be occupied like a shelter; trial applies load and reveals whether its supporting allegiance is protective or structurally weak.
changed_reading.before: The declaration is a label that should secure non-interference.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shelter/load-test mechanism is cross-domain and the packet never calls the profession a house; it remains anchored through the focus roots of security, static leaving, and assay, then receives a concrete weak-shelter mechanism in 29:41. Render it as an analogy for false reliance, never as a lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Claimed security expects to remain undisturbed and unassayed.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Faith as assayed material.** ف ت ن B001 is “assaying by trial.” The sequence saying “we believe” → not being left → being assayed assigns the assay the role of exposing what the utterance contains. The directional claim—that pressure reveals rather than creates the quality—is inferred; the ayah therefore reads as a demand that spoken faith become publicly testable material.
2. **An anticipatory fire-reading.** ف ت ن B002 is “burning by fire.” Nothing in this ayah itself supplies flame, but the later command to burn Abraham gives the branch a visible material activator. Exploratorily, the test is not only generic hardship: it can be read as exposure to a heat that separates durable commitment from verbal surface.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:24's literal burning activates ف ت ن B002 retrospectively, while 29:65's shipboard sincerity shows another assay exposing what ordinary safety covers. Together they preserve both the heat-separation and disclosure readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A spoken claim must become assayable evidence.** Lexical evidence: `أَحَسِبَ`, root `ح س ب`, `B002` (reckoning as supposition); `يَقُولُوا`, root `ق و ل`, `B001` (uttered speech); `ءَامَنَّا`, root `ء م ن`, `B002` (trusting assent); and `يُفْتَنُونَ`, root `ف ت ن`, `B001` (assaying by trial). Structural cue: `29:3` repeats assay and sets truth/falsehood on opposite sides of disclosed knowledge, while `29:4` repeats the faulty reckoning. Assigned role: assay converts an unverified utterance into differentiating evidence. Abductive move: the packet supplies claim, assay, and subsequent distinction; I infer the evidentiary arrow from trial to manifested quality. Reading change: the question challenges not faith itself but the supposition that saying it completes its verification.

2. **Not being left means not being frozen in a merely verbal state.** Lexical evidence: passive `يُتْرَكُوا`, root `ت ر ك`, `B003` (leaving a thing in a state). Structural cue: `29:6-7` replace verbal stasis with strenuous self-directed effort and intentional sound work. Assigned role: `ت ر ك B003` supplies the unrealized condition in which the speakers expect to remain. Abductive move: action in the later edge of the focus window does not lexically define `يتركوا`; I infer that it shows what trial prevents: an assent that never acquires enacted form. Reading change: the ayah asks whether people expect their self-description to remain untouched rather than be carried into consequential action.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:65-67`):** Shipboard danger produces unmixed submission, safety produces renewed partnership, and protected sanctuary coexists with trust in voidness. This late pressure reversal gives the clearest assay of `ءَامَنَّا`: trial tests whether assent remains attached to its object when the safety-state changes.

words.gloss_range: rhetorical supposing or reckoning, locally challenging the completed assumption that speech can secure exemption from testing
words.prose: The first proposition-bearing word, {{ar:أَحَسِبَ}} ({{tr:ʾa-ḥasiba}}), makes the ayah a challenge from the outset. Its perfect form treats the assumption as a settled miscalculation, and its governed clauses unfold the calculation: people imagine being left, offer a speech-claim as warrant, and expect no testing. The boundary can also be heard two ways: as a fresh question after 29:1 or, in the connected variant, as a challenge flowing from 29:1, while the interrogative force remains intact. The root pressure is reckoning rather than neutral thinking, while recurrence at 29:4 and the exemption-question echo at 9:16 keep this opening inside a wider pattern of denied exemption.
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes supposing, reckoning, account, and sufficiency pressure; local grammar selects mental reckoning while accounting pressure remains relevant

topics.headline: rhetorical challenge over reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah open as a challenge to a settled calculation, not as neutral information about what people think.
topics.reason: The interrogative prefix on the perfect cognition verb opens the matrix question and scopes over the full supposition.

topics.headline: nested object clauses expose the reasoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the false reasoning laid out in layers: supposed exemption, speech offered as warrant, then denied escape from testing.
topics.reason: The matrix verb takes the long clausal complement, and the later governed saying clause explains the speech-claim inside that reckoning.

topics.headline: supposition with accounting pressure

topics.reason: Local grammar selects the mental supposition sense, while root-family account and sufficiency pressures sharpen the error without replacing the local verb with arithmetic counting or direct sufficiency.

topics.headline: recitational boundary affects entry into the question

topics.reason: The variant affects recitational segmentation at the boundary, but it does not alter the local interrogative parse of the word.

words.gloss_range: the definite generic human collective, locally the overt subject whose claim and exposure run through the whole ayah
words.prose: {{ar:النَّاسُ}} ({{tr:al-nāsu}}) names the questioned party broadly. With no prior referent supplied, the definite noun works generically, and the later plural markers keep returning to the same humans as the grammar shifts them from reckoning agents to quoted speakers and then to tested patients. Derivational pressure can make the subject feel like socially aware yet forgetful humans, but the local function remains the generic human collective that opens a same-surah public-response thread at 29:10.

topics.headline: one human referent threads all clauses

topics.headline: social perception and forgetting pressure the noun

words.gloss_range: subjunctive complement particle that packages the following passive leaving clause as the content of the challenged supposition
words.prose: The first {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) makes the next event a governed object of reckoning. Its light surface carries heavy syntactic work: the passive leaving clause is not asserted on its own, but turned into the false premise that the opening challenge examines.

topics.headline: first particle turns being-left into the object of reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the imagined exemption packaged as the content being challenged, not as an independent event.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following subjunctive passive and opens the clausal complement of the matrix reckoning verb.

words.gloss_range: passive being left or allowed to remain without intervention, locally the imagined exemption from testing inside the challenged supposition
words.prose: {{ar:يُتْرَكُوا}} ({{tr:yutrakū}}) is the wished-for exemption in passive form. The people are carried from the generic subject into a patient role: not active leavers, but ones imagining they will be left without intervention. The root can carry abandonment and what remains afterward, so the word does not sound like neutral absence only; and the close exemption-question echo at 9:16 plus the accountability echo at 75:36 make this passive status a marked thing to deny.
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes leaving, abandoning, letting remain, relinquishing, and what is left behind; local passive selects being left untested while consequence pressure remains audible

topics.headline: passive subjunctive imagines exemption as received status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that people are not pictured leaving on their own; they imagine being granted non-intervention as passive recipients.
topics.reason: The passive subjunctive after the first particle keeps the action embedded in the false supposition and suppresses the agent of leaving.

topics.headline: leaving ranges from abandonment to remaining with consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that being left is not a harmless vacancy; root pressure allows abandonment, remaining, and consequence to haunt the wished-for exemption.
topics.reason: Local grammar selects passive being left without intervention, while root-family branches of abandonment or what is left behind add consequence pressure without making bequeathing the local sense.

topics.headline: being-left belongs to an accountability-denial formula

words.gloss_range: second subjunctive particle introducing the speech clause, locally live between complement/appositional routing and causal ground
words.prose: The second {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) is the hinge into the speech-claim. It governs the saying verb, but the row evidence keeps the relation live: the profession may be heard as another embedded content clause or as the alleged reason people expect to be left. Either way, speech becomes part of the faulty reasoning, not a detached report.

topics.headline: second particle routes speech as complement or ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech claim is not loose quotation; it is grammatically tied to why the people expect exemption.
topics.reason: The input preserves complement and causal parses, so the word is best kept as a live routing point: the saying clause is either further content under the reckoning or the alleged cause for being left.

words.gloss_range: governed public saying or claiming, locally introducing the quoted profession as evidence inside the challenged reasoning
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُوا}} ({{tr:yaqūlū}}) makes the claim audible as speech. The same humans actively say the profession, while the surrounding passive verbs make them recipients of the imagined exemption and the coming proof. The word therefore separates utterance from verified reality without pre-condemning the utterance as fabricated, and same-surah recurrence at 29:10 shows this speech-and-faith problem becoming concrete.
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on saying, speech, report, claim, and specialized speech-related constructions; local form is ordinary public saying, not explicit fabrication

topics.headline: ordinary saying becomes a claim needing verification

words.gloss_range: completed first-plural faith/trust profession, locally quoted as the claim whose adequacy is tested
words.prose: {{ar:آمَنَّا}} ({{tr:āmannā}}) is the human claim in its own voice: a first-plural perfect that presents belief as already accomplished. The root range makes the claim heavier than private opinion, because faith, trust, security, and entrusted reliability are all close enough to press on the profession. That claim is then balanced against the denied testing process; 2:8 gives a contested profession parallel, while 29:7 later contrasts bare profession with faith joined to deeds.
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes faith, trust, security, safety, and entrusted reliability; local form is a profession of faith/trust with security-status pressure

It explicitly brings the same humans back into view after their quoted first-person claim, making them the subject of the imagined state: they, not being tested. The shift from quoted we to evaluated they lets the ayah quote self-certification and then place the speakers under outside judgment.

words.gloss_range: simple negation scoped over the following testing verb, locally naming the imagined absence of trial
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) narrows the target of the false expectation. It does not negate the speech-claim or the whole supposition; it negates being tested inside the circumstantial clause. Because it is simple negation before an indicative imperfect, the wished-for state is broad non-testing, and the ayah lets that polarity sit just before the closing trial verb.

words.gloss_range: passive being tested, tried, or proved under pressure, locally the denied absence of verification after a faith claim
words.prose: {{ar:يُفْتَنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuftanūna}}) is the landing word. It makes the same humans patients of testing, not agents of it, and its indicative form stands apart from the earlier embedded subjunctives. The root range lets the testing feel like fire-refining assay, not random hardship, while the local passive keeps the selected sense to being proved under trial. It also answers the earlier passive of being left: the same patient morphology contrasts hoped-for non-intervention with unavoidable proving pressure. The suppressed agency in 29:2 is answered by active divine testing in 29:3, and the same-surah thread continues at 29:10.
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes testing, trial, temptation, affliction, burning, smelting, and refinement; local passive selects being proved under pressure with assay imagery in the background
